title: Experts say AI has made planning cyberattacks on industrial equipment faster by helping attackers read manuals and research past accidents more quickly (Tom Wilson/Financial Times)
summary: Tom Wilson / Financial Times: Experts say AI has made planning cyberattacks on industrial equipment faster by helping attackers read manuals and research past accidents more quickly — The freezer war is just a start.
